visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Six women are positioned in a modern, warm-lit studio. Three sit at a white marble table in the foreground, and three stand behind a dark leather sofa. The background features dark wooden shelves with decorative items. Lighting is soft and bright indoor. (2) A black Chanel logo appears as an overlay. The women begin rhythmic hand gestures, including pointing and swaying, synchronized to an unseen beat. Their facial expressions are neutral and engaging. (3) The logo transitions to Hermès Paris. The group continues their synchronized movements, waving and pointing towards the camera. The setting and lighting remain consistent as they maintain their poses. (4) A PS5 console graphic appears. The women's movements increase in energy; the central woman in yellow points upward while the others sway. The background shelves and furniture provide a stable, high-end context. (5) A Nintendo Switch 2 logo is displayed. The group becomes more animated with clapping and rhythmic arm sways. Facial expressions remain engaged and smiling throughout the transition. (6) A graphic for a Valve Steam Machine appears. The women react with high visible arousal, leaning forward onto the table and expressing excitement through facial gestures.
